cluster_title: v2 UI projections — S1 Work overview (AC-UI-01-05/06/07) + S2 Why & Unknowns (AC-UI-02) measured on REAL x79 turns
auditor: independent measurement engineer (read-only on repo + x79)
headline: S1 is correct on real data (3276/3276 rows, 0 ordering inversions, badges and completeness exact). S2 does NOT render recorded values: basis, unknowns, rule_version and previous_verdict are never recorded in x79, so 3276/3276 frames carry fabricated content and 3185 frames state 'nothing unknown' while the same frame reports an insufficient verdict with 1-3 gaps.

data_source.path_named_state: EMPTY — `file` reports 'empty', `sqlite3 .tables` returns nothing. The repo-side file is a 0-byte stub because harness.config.json declares a RELATIVE storage.sqlite.path, which observe-config.mjs treats as a legacy hint and ignores.
data_source.copy: /tmp/eso-dd/ui-src/x79.db (+ -wal, -shm), WAL preserved so the 4.7 MB unfinalized WAL stays readable

turn_source_query: SELECT dl.id, dl.request_id, dl.created_at, dl.jev_response_json, r.user_query, r.prompt_at, r.created_at, r.status, r.checks_pass, r.checks_fail FROM decision_ledger dl JOIN request r ON r.id = dl.request_id WHERE dl.event_type = 'evidence_sufficiency' ORDER BY dl.created_at ASC, dl.id ASC

adapter.harness: /tmp/eso-dd/ui-measure.mjs (imports the real eso/core/src/ui-frames.mjs — no copy, no edit)

mapping_s1.missing: jev_response_json.$.gaps[] rendered as '<kind>: <query>' — DB field is `gaps`, module field is `missing`, the rename is mandatory
mapping_s1.completeness: jev_response_json.$.sufficiency.score (treated as the completeness ratio; naming is an adapter assumption, see notes)
mapping_s1.created_at: request.prompt_at, locale form 'Monday, Oct 12, 2026, 6:00 PM (UTC+7)'; 3236 non-null, 40 NULL

mapping_s2.record.evidence: check_result rows with status != 'skip' (verdict.evidenceBundleRef is JSON null on all 3276)
mapping_s2.record.basis: NOT RECORDED — 0 occurrences of 'basis' in decision_ledger.jev_response_json and event.raw_json
mapping_s2.record.rule_version: NOT RECORDED — 0 occurrences of 'ruleVersion'/'rule_version' in decision_ledger or event; adapter derived 1 from verdict.contractVersion '1.0.0' (best effort, flagged as inference)
mapping_s2.record.previous_verdict: NOT RECORDED — 0 occurrences of 'previ*' in the ledger JSON

stories.title: US-UI-01 S1 Work overview
acs: AC-UI-01-05 warning on the right row
stories.evidence: 3276 rows; badge on 3271 expected rows, 0 on clean rows, badge number == gap count on 3271; completeness bar on 3271 rows with ratio identical to the recorded score and absent on all 5 score-1.0 rows; 0 ordering inversions against an independent epoch parse (also 0 under TZ=UTC); level echo 3276/3276; missing_count 3276/3276; deterministic across reruns; badge-to-turn binding stable over 5 shuffles.
stories.incidental: AC-UI-01-01 EMPTY ok, AC-UI-01-04 DENIED ok with the identical phrase, AC-UI-01-11 has_write_buttons=false, AC-UI-01-12 styling ok

stories.title: US-UI-02 S2 Why & Unknowns
acs: AC-UI-02 render recorded values, no recompute
stories.evidence: verdict echo 3276/3276 (good); evidence echo 3276/3276 (good, but 3239 are empty arrays with no 'not recorded' marker); basis = 'declared' on 3276/3276 although no basis is recorded and 'declared' is outside BASES {inferred,retrieved,verified}; unknowns = 'không có gì chưa biết' on 3185/3276 turns that DO have 1-3 gaps; stale-rule banner 'theo luật cũ (v1)' on 3276/3276; previous_verdict placeholder 'không có mục này' on 3276/3276; AC-UI-02-01 EMPTY is unreachable with real data (0 turns lack a record).

defects.title: S2 prints a basis nobody recorded ('declared'), outside its own closed vocabulary
defects.proof: x79 stores no basis at all (0 occurrences of 'basis' in decision_ledger.jev_response_json and event.raw_json); ui-frames.mjs:171 `part_3_basis: rec.basis || 'declared'` therefore emits 'declared' on 3276/3276 real frames, while eso/core/src/types.mjs:32 BASES = [inferred, retrieved, verified]. The user reads a basis that was never measured and is not a legal basis value.

defects.title: 'không có gì chưa biết' rendered on 3185 turns whose own verdict is insufficient/partial with gaps
defects.proof: part_4_unknowns is filled from rec.unknowns, which x79 never records; gaps live in jev_response_json.$.gaps (2 gaps on 3108 turns, 3 on 50, 1 on 27). Fabricated placeholder count = 3185 = 3158 insufficient + 27 partial-with-gaps, so the same frame says 'insufficient' in part_1 and 'nothing unknown' in part_4.

defects.title: Stale-rule banner fires on 100% of real turns because rule_version is never recorded
defects.proof: 0 occurrences of 'ruleVersion'/'rule_version' in decision_ledger or event; the only version present is verdict.contractVersion '1.0.0'. ui-frames.mjs:151 defaults rule_version to 1 and :147 currentRuleVersion to 4, so every one of the 3276 frames renders 'theo luật cũ (v1)'. An unconditional banner carries no signal.

defects.title: Badge reads '⚠ 0 thiếu' on 86 partial turns with zero recorded gaps
defects.proof: jev_response_json.$.gaps has length 0 on 86 turns whose sufficiency.level = 'partial'. ui-frames.mjs:108-122 derives isPartial from level OR gaps but the badge text from gaps.length alone, so 86 rows show a warning badge whose number contradicts its own text.

defects.title: Warning coverage collapses from 3271 to 113 rows if the caller passes DB shape (gaps) instead of module shape (missing)
defects.proof: Same 3276 turns with the field not renamed: 113 badges instead of 3271 (only the level==='partial' branch survives), so 3158 insufficient turns silently lose their S1 warning. The module's input contract names a field (`missing`) that exists in no x79 table, and nothing validates or documents the rename — the only consumer is a QC fixture hardcoding missing:['m1','m2'].

defects.title: previous_verdict placeholder 'không có mục này' on every turn, including brand-new ones
defects.proof: 0 occurrences of 'previ*' in decision_ledger JSON; ui-frames.mjs:175 sets old_record_missing_field whenever rec.previous_verdict is falsy, so 3276/3276 frames claim a field is missing from an old record when the field is simply not part of the data model.

defects.title: Evidence section renders as an empty list for 3239/3276 turns with no explanation
defects.proof: evidenceBundleRef is JSON null on all 3276 and only 37 turns have any non-skip check_result, so part_2_evidence = [] for 3239 turns — unlike unknowns, which at least gets a placeholder string. An empty list is indistinguishable from 'evidence cleared'.

defects.title: S1 never downgrades to ST5 PARTIAL: 3271/3276 turns are below sufficient yet the frame is READY
defects.proof: s1.state = READY for all 3276 rows while 3271 rows carry an insufficient/partial verdict. ST5_PARTIAL exists in renderStateFrame but projectS1WorkOverview has no path to it.

defects.title: Named DB path is a 0-byte stub; real turn data lives in ~/.harness/observe/x79
defects.proof: x79/.harness/harness.db = 0 bytes while harness.config.json declares a relative storage.sqlite.path that observe-config.mjs ignores. A measurement or UI pointed at the documented path sees zero turns and renders EMPTY instead of an error.

unmeasurable_no_client: Visual/DOM placement of the AC-UI-01-05 warning ('on the right row' verified at frame level only: correct turn_id, correct count). No S1/S2 component exists — grep for missing_badge|completeness_bar|four_parts|BACK_TO_S1 across the monorepo returns only qc/eso-core-host-ui.test.mjs.
Click behaviour: actions:['WHY'] and back_action:'BACK_TO_S1' are string tokens with no handler, so 'opens S2' / 'preserves S1 selection' cannot be exercised.
ST2_LOADING and ST3_FAILED: no transport layer, so skeletons and retry cannot be measured.
AC-UI-01-11 'zero write buttons': only the frame flag has_write_buttons=false is observable; there is no UI in which to count affordances.
hasAccess/DENIED path: no caller supplies hasAccess, so the DENIED frame is unreachable from any real client (verified synthetically only).
Vietnamese copy quality, truncation, pagination and accessibility of very long user_query prompts — no renderer.

Whether jev_response_json.$.sufficiency.score is the 'completeness' the AC intends: no schema or doc binds completeness to that column, so the ratio mapping is an adapter assumption, not a measured fact.
notes: S1's three assigned ACs survive real data cleanly; the failure localises to S2 and specifically to fields the projection invents when x79 records nothing (basis, unknowns, rule_version, previous_verdict).

Fix direction implied by the numbers: emit an explicit 'not-recorded' marker instead of defaults — that turns 3276 fabricated basis values and 3185 false 'nothing unknown' into honest NULL states — and source rule_version from the ledger rather than defaulting to 1 against a hardcoded 4.

Ordering is robust here (0 inversions, including TZ=UTC) but it sorts a locale string ('Monday, Oct 12, 2026, 6:00 PM (UTC+7)') through new Date(); it only survives because the adapter passes prompt_at on a UTC+7 host — request.created_at is ingest-backfill time (566 equal-timestamp adjacent pairs).
